subject: Invitation to Annual Company Gala
body: Dear Employees, We are excited to invite you to our annual company gala at the Grand Hotel on December 15th. Join us for an evening of celebration, networking, and entertainment. The event will start at 7:00 PM with a cocktail reception followed by dinner and a live band. Please RSVP by December 5th to secure your spot. We look forward to seeing you there! Best regards, The Organizing Committee
